```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ieugwasr)
source("check_overlap.R")

plink2_bin <- Sys.getenv("PLINK2", unset = "plink2")
bfile <- "ldref/1000G/EUR.chrpos"
```


# check LD overlap with Howe et al.

```{r}
howe <- tophits(
  id = 'ieu-b-4813',
  pval = 1e-6,
  clump = 0,
  pop = 'EUR'
)

res_pop_z <- run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe,
    method = 'population_z_test',
    procedure = 'bh',
    pval = 1e-6
)
res_z <- run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe,
    method = 'z_test',
    procedure = 'bh',
    pval = 1e-6
)

res_npmle <- run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe,
    method = 'npmle',
    procedure = 'bh',
    pval = 1e-6
)

res_param <- run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe,
    method = 'parametric',
    procedure = 'bh',
    pval = 1e-6
)

res_npmle$summary_table
res_param$summary_table
res_z$summary_table
res_pop_z$summary_table
```


## random 5,000

```{r}
set.seed(20260505)

random_5000_n_iter <- 50
random_5000_n_snps <- 5000
random_5000_procedure <- "random_5000"
random_5000_base_dir <- file.path("results", "random_5000_discovery_sets")
random_5000_out_dir <- file.path("results", "random_5000_howe_overlap")

dir.create(
  file.path(random_5000_base_dir, random_5000_procedure, "chromosome_position"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
dir.create(
  file.path(random_5000_base_dir, random_5000_procedure, "snp_ids"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
dir.create(random_5000_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sumstats <- fread("height_matched_to_1000GEUR.sumstats")
sumstats[, `:=`(
  chromosome = as.integer(chromosome),
  pos = as.integer(pos),
  chr_pos = paste0(chromosome, ":", pos)
)]

bim <- fread(paste0(bfile, ".bim"), header = FALSE)
setnames(bim, c("chr", "chr_pos", "cm", "bp", "a1", "a2"))

random_5000_pool <- unique(
  sumstats[chr_pos %in% bim$chr_pos, .(chromosome, pos, SNP, chr_pos)],
  by = "chr_pos"
)

stopifnot(nrow(random_5000_pool) >= random_5000_n_snps)


random_5000_results <- lapply(seq_len(random_5000_n_iter), function(iter) {
  method_name <- sprintf("random_5000_iter_%02d", iter)
  random_set <- random_5000_pool[
    sample.int(.N, random_5000_n_snps),
    .(chromosome, pos, SNP)
  ]
  
  fwrite(
    random_set[, .(chromosome, pos)],
    file.path(
      random_5000_base_dir,
      random_5000_procedure,
      "chromosome_position",
      paste0(method_name, "_discoveries_chr_pos.txt")
    ),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  fwrite(
    random_set[, .(SNP)],
    file.path(
      random_5000_base_dir,
      random_5000_procedure,
      "snp_ids",
      paste0(method_name, "_discoveries_snp_ids.txt")
    ),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  res <- run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe,
    method = method_name,
    procedure = random_5000_procedure,
    base_dir = random_5000_base_dir,
    out_dir = random_5000_out_dir,
    bfile = bfile,
    ld_window_kb = 250,
    ld_window_r2 = 0.8
  )
  
  res$summary_table[, iteration := iter]
  res$summary_table
})

random_5000_summary <- rbindlist(random_5000_results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

random_5000_average <- random_5000_summary[
  ,
  .(
    mean_count = mean(count),
    sd_count = sd(count),
    min_count = min(count),
    max_count = max(count)
  ),
  by = category
]

random_5000_average[
  category %in% c(
    "Discovery SNPs exact-matched to Howe",
    "Discovery SNPs non-exact LD-proxy matched to Howe",
    "Discovery SNPs exact or non-exact LD-proxy matched to Howe"
  )
]
```

# LD clump discovery sets, then match clumped discoveries to Howe

```{r}
clump_input_base_dir <- "results/discovery_sets_bh"
clump_output_base_dir <- file.path("results", "clumped_discovery_sets")
clump_plink_out_dir <- file.path("results", "discovery_clumping_plink")
clumped_howe_overlap_out_dir <- file.path("results", "clumped_discovery_howe_overlap")

dir.create(clump_output_base_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clump_plink_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(clumped_howe_overlap_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

clump_discovery_set <- function(
    method,
    procedure = "bh",
    input_base_dir = clump_input_base_dir,
    output_base_dir = clump_output_base_dir,
    plink_out_dir = clump_plink_out_dir,
    plink2_bin = NULL,
    ref_bfile = NULL,
    clump_kb = 250,
    clump_r2 = 0.1) {
  if (is.null(plink2_bin)) {
    plink2_bin <- get("plink2_bin", envir = parent.frame())
  }
  if (is.null(ref_bfile)) {
    ref_bfile <- get("bfile", envir = parent.frame())
  }
  
  disc_file <- file.path(
    input_base_dir,
    procedure,
    "chromosome_position",
    paste0(method, "_discoveries_chr_pos.txt")
  )
  
  disc <- fread(disc_file)
  disc[, `:=`(
    chromosome = as.integer(chromosome),
    pos = as.integer(pos),
    chr_pos = paste0(chromosome, ":", pos)
  )]
  disc <- unique(disc, by = "chr_pos")
  
  bim <- fread(paste0(ref_bfile, ".bim"), header = FALSE)
  setnames(bim, c("chr", "chr_pos", "cm", "bp", "a1", "a2"))
  
  disc_in_ref <- disc[chr_pos %in% bim$chr_pos]
  
  assoc_file <- file.path(plink_out_dir, paste0(method, "_", procedure, "_clump_input.tsv"))
  extract_file <- file.path(plink_out_dir, paste0(method, "_", procedure, "_extract.txt"))
  out_prefix <- file.path(plink_out_dir, paste0(method, "_", procedure, "_clumped"))
  
  ## Discovery files only contain coordinates. Use a constant small P-value
  ## so PLINK can LD-clump the set; ties are resolved by PLINK/input order.
  fwrite(
    data.table(
      ID = disc_in_ref$chr_pos,
      P = 1e-12
    ),
    assoc_file,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  writeLines(disc_in_ref$chr_pos, extract_file)
  
  plink_args <- c(
    "--bfile", ref_bfile,
    "--extract", extract_file,
    "--clump", assoc_file,
    "--clump-id-field", "ID",
    "--clump-p-field", "P",
    "--clump-p1", "1",
    "--clump-p2", "1",
    "--clump-r2", as.character(clump_r2),
    "--clump-kb", as.character(clump_kb),
    "--clump-unphased",
    "--out", out_prefix
  )
  
  status <- system2(plink2_bin, args = plink_args)
  if (status != 0) {
    stop("PLINK clumping failed. Check log file: ", paste0(out_prefix, ".log"))
  }
  
  clump_file <- paste0(out_prefix, ".clumps")
  if (!file.exists(clump_file)) {
    stop("Expected PLINK clump output not found: ", clump_file)
  }
  
  clumped <- fread(clump_file)
  clumped_ids <- unique(clumped$ID)
  
  clumped_chr_pos <- tstrsplit(clumped_ids, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  clumped_disc <- data.table(
    chromosome = as.integer(clumped_chr_pos[[1]]),
    pos = as.integer(clumped_chr_pos[[2]])
  )
  
  clumped_chr_pos_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, procedure, "chromosome_position")
  clumped_snp_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, procedure, "snp_ids")
  dir.create(clumped_chr_pos_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(clumped_snp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  fwrite(
    clumped_disc,
    file.path(clumped_chr_pos_dir, paste0(method, "_discoveries_chr_pos.txt")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  fwrite(
    data.table(SNP = clumped_ids),
    file.path(clumped_snp_dir, paste0(method, "_discoveries_snp_ids.txt")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  data.table(
    method = method,
    procedure = procedure,
    clump_kb = clump_kb,
    clump_r2 = clump_r2,
    n_discoveries = uniqueN(disc$chr_pos),
    n_discoveries_in_ref = uniqueN(disc_in_ref$chr_pos),
    n_clumped_discoveries = uniqueN(clumped_ids),
    clumped_file = clump_file
  )
}

clump_procedure <- "bh"
clump_methods <- c(
  "npmle",
  "parametric",
  "z_test",
  "population_z_test"
)

clumped_discovery_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(clump_methods, function(method_name) {
  clump_discovery_set(
    method = method_name,
    procedure = clump_procedure,
    clump_kb = 250,
    clump_r2 = 0.1
  )
}), use.names = TRUE)


clumped_discovery_summary
```

```{r}
howe_for_clumped_overlap <- tophits(
  id = "ieu-b-4813",
  pval = 1e-6,
  clump = 0,
  pop = "EUR"
)

clumped_howe_overlap_results <- lapply(clump_methods, function(method_name) {
  run_howe_overlap(
    howe = howe_for_clumped_overlap,
    method = method_name,
    procedure = clump_procedure,
    base_dir = clump_output_base_dir,
    out_dir = clumped_howe_overlap_out_dir,
    ld_window_kb = 250,
    ld_window_r2 = 0.8
  )
})

names(clumped_howe_overlap_results) <- clump_methods

clumped_howe_overlap_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(
  clumped_howe_overlap_results,
  function(x) x$summary_table
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

clumped_howe_overlap_summary
```

```{r}
clumped_howe_overlap_breakdown <- rbindlist(lapply(names(clumped_howe_overlap_results), function(method_name) {
  res <- clumped_howe_overlap_results[[method_name]]
  n_after_clumping <- clumped_discovery_summary[
    method == method_name,
    n_clumped_discoveries
  ][1]
  
  exact_and_ld <- intersect(res$exact_overlap, res$ld_matched_discovery)
  exact_only <- setdiff(res$exact_overlap, res$ld_matched_discovery)
  ld_only <- setdiff(res$ld_matched_discovery, res$exact_overlap)
  
  data.table(
    method = method_name,
    category = c(
      "Discovery SNPs after clumping",
      "Exact only",
      "Non-exact LD-proxy only",
      "Both exact and non-exact LD-proxy",
      "Exact or non-exact LD-proxy"
    ),
    count = c(
      n_after_clumping,
      length(exact_only),
      length(ld_only),
      length(exact_and_ld),
      length(res$matched_discovery)
    )
  )
}), use.names = TRUE)

clumped_howe_overlap_breakdown
```
